logo.note: GitHub's Invertocat, since Primer has no mark of its own (primer.style's header uses it beside the name), unaltered, from https://brand.github.com/foundations/logo. Shown at the request of Polyxd's maintainer to identify the design system this pack is modelled on. GitHub's guidelines: Unmodified permitted GitHub logos may be used to link to GitHub, show integration, or in articles about GitHub, placed secondary and never implying affiliation or combined with other words; any other use needs GitHub's prior written permission.

provenance.notes: Primer's base and functional scales and its two theme files are vendored verbatim under scripts/sources/primer; the generator reads their custom properties.
